title: Most People Use AI Completely Wrong 🤯
description:
Most people pick one AI and use it for everything.

That's a mistake.

🤖 ChatGPT → Research, learning, and building
⚡ Claude → Projects, coding, and deep thinking
🖼️ Gemini → Multimodal tasks and Google ecosystem
📈 Grok → Real-time information and trends

Different tools. Different strengths.

Use the best AI for the job.
